6078957_aef2bbcc.text: The second class of cells consisted of late-firing neurons
6078957_aef2bbcc.section: Basolateral amygdala and corticobasal cell types

6078957_d8ca2bac.text: The third class of cells, termed fast-firing neurons, possessed many of the features of intrinsic inhibitory interneurons found elsewhere in the brain
6078957_d8ca2bac.section: Basolateral amygdala and corticobasal cell types

6078957_3d072d3b.text: Our data support the conclusion derived from previous anatomical studies that pyramidal neurons constitute the predominant cell type in the BLA and function as projection neurons in this region of the amygdala.
